The PR changes Codex native `commandExecution` side-effect classification to call `isMutatingToolCall`, exports that helper from `agent-harness-runtime`, updates Plugin SDK surface budgets, and adds projector regression cases.

PR surface: Source +1, Tests +43, Other 0. Total +44 across 4 files.

Reproducibility: yes. at source level. Current main treats read-only shell commands as non-mutating, still marks `exec`/`bash` replay-unsafe, and the incomplete-turn retry gate skips attempts with side-effect replay metadata.

target.title: fix(codex): classify commandExecution mutability via shared isMutatingToolCall
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #101890 — strict-agentic retry cannot retry terminal turns that only
performed read-only inspection tools because `isMutatingNativeToolItem` always
treats `commandExecution` items as mutating.

## Root Cause

`isMutatingNativeToolItem` returns `true` for all `commandExecution` items,
classifying even read-only commands (grep, ls, rg, cat) as having side effects.

## Fix

1. Export `isMutatingToolCall` through the plugin SDK (`agent-harness-runtime`)
   alongside the already-exported `isReplaySafeToolCall`
2. Use `isMutatingToolCall("exec", itemToolArgs(item))` in
   `isMutatingNativeToolItem` instead of `return true`

## Evidence

### Runtime Proof

The regression test exercises the production `CodexAppServerEventProjector` —
the exact code path that classifies turns for strict-agentic retry:

```
✓ rg TODO src/agents     → replaySafe: true   (read-only)
✓ grep -r foo .          → replaySafe: true   (read-only)
✓ ls -la                 → replaySafe: true   (read-only)
✓ cat package.json       → replaySafe: true   (read-only)
✓ echo hello > /tmp/out  → replaySafe: false  (redirect)
✓ rm -rf /tmp/cache      → replaySafe: false  (mutating)
✓ npm install            → replaySafe: false  (mutating)
```

The projector receives real `turn/completed` notifications with
`commandExecution` items, runs the full `isMutatingNativeToolItem →
isSideEffectingNativeToolItem → recordToolMeta → sideEffectingToolItemIds →
hadPotentialSideEffects → replayMetadata` chain, and returns correct
classification.

### Source-Level Proof

```
isMutatingToolCall("exec", { command: "rg TODO src" })   → false
isMutatingToolCall("exec", { command: "rm -rf /tmp" })   → true
```

### Autoreview (claude-sonnet-5)

```
→ patch is correct (0.98), no accepted/actionable findings
```

- [x] `oxfmt --check` passes
- [x] `oxlint` passes
- [x] SDK test 9/9 passed
- [x] Projector regression test 7/7 passed
- [x] autoreview clean (claude-sonnet-5, 0.98)
